evidence.quote: a commitment that a soak doesn't get shortened because a date slipped

observations.why: Demands operational stability, predictability, and protection of supervisor floor capacity against schedule slippage.

evidence.quote: That's fair and I'll hold it.

observations.why: Ratifies an explicit appeal to fairness and commits to upholding operational protection for others.

evidence.quote: Two weeks was conservative in a place where being conservative was cheap.

observations.why: Weighs the value of conservative safety margins against analytical defensibility and tightness.

evidence.quote: I'd rather be defensible and know where the slack isn't than conservative for a reason that turned out to be imaginary.

observations.why: Explicitly values empirical defensibility and epistemic rigor over false or unmeasured safety buffers.

evidence.quote: the basis was never measured; two weeks is a guess

observations.why: Rejects an operational standard on the grounds that it lacks empirical measurement and constitutes an unverified guess.

mints.title: defensible rather than conservative for an imaginary reason
mints.frame: Does this expression prioritize verified empirical defensibility over ungrounded safety buffers?
